topic: Three lunar rovers left on the Moon
hook: Your Moon visit would find three parked cars.
title: Three Cars Are Still Parked on the Moon
description:
Apollo 15, 16 and 17 each left a lunar rover on the Moon where the crews drove it last. They are still up there today. Series: If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #Space #Apollo
comment_prompt: Would you drive one? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your Moon visit would find three parked cars.
scenes.headline: PARKED ON THE MOON

scenes.narration: They're lunar rovers from Apollo 15, 16 and 17.
scenes.headline: APOLLO 15, 16, 17

scenes.narration: Astronauts drove them across the surface.
scenes.headline: DRIVEN BY ASTRONAUTS

scenes.narration: Then they left them right where they stopped.
scenes.headline: LEFT WHERE STOPPED

scenes.narration: No rain or air means no rust.
scenes.headline: NO RAIN, NO RUST

scenes.narration: They've been sitting there since the early 1970s.
scenes.headline: SINCE THE 1970s

scenes.narration: So yes, three cars are parked on the Moon.
scenes.headline: STILL PARKED

scenes.headline: TOMORROW
